claim: You can limit the upload throughput from an S3 File Gateway to AWS to control the network bandwidth it uses; by default an activated gateway has no rate limits.
question: Can you throttle S3 File Gateway uploads, and what is the default?

values.display: an activated gateway has no rate limits
